C1176.title: SoundCloud Data Exposure: Nearly 30 Million Accounts Affected by API Enumeration Abuse
C1176.summary: SoundCloud experienced a data exposure incident impacting nearly 30 million user accounts. The event resulted from data enumeration and API abuse rather than a direct database breach. Attackers performed large-scale data enumeration through API endpoints to harvest user information.
